verified: World Nuclear News reports that Hochul announced completion of the Master Plan for Responsible Advanced Nuclear Development and that it sets a 5 GW new nuclear capacity target.
unconfirmed: which reactor technologies or project sites the plan favours, the timeline for construction, the cost, and any siting, permitting or procurement measures — the report gives none of these details.

verified: 据世界核能新闻报道，州长凯西·霍楚尔宣布《负责任先进核能开发总体规划》已完成，该规划为实现新增5吉瓦核电装机容量的目标制定了路线图。
unconfirmed: 规划包含哪些具体项目、采用何种反应堆技术、项目选址在哪里、资金从何而来、需要经过哪些审批和开工时间安排，以及5吉瓦目标能否落实；报道未给出任何日期，也未说明州议会或监管机构后续将如何审议。

titles.en: New York completes master plan for 5 GW of advanced nuclear
titles.zh: 纽约州公布先进核能总体规划，目标新增5吉瓦
